observations.result: State, contracts, architecture, distribution metadata, strict typecheck, 64 tests with 311 expectations, Electron compilation, Knip and report-only Fallow health all pass; Fallow health is 89.0/A with only the pre-existing scripts/status.ts collectRow moderate advisory and documented distribution warnings.
No issues in the 11 changed implementation, UI, fixture and test files for this grounded-retrieval increment.
No unused files, dependencies or exports reported.
64 tests with 311 expectations pass, including scoped retrieval, pre-read exclusions, source revision citations, missing-evidence handling, IPC validation and journey entry-point coverage.
Main 84.36 KB, preload 3.71 KB and renderer 74.34 KB bundles compile with retrieval IPC, progress events and the grounded-search workspace panel.

implemented: Added a local hybrid retrieval broker that combines exact term scoring with deterministic local feature-vector similarity and supports bounded folder, path, tag and modified-date scope filters.
Applied default application-data exclusions and user exclusions before reading candidate content, and emitted progress events with indexed, excluded and scoped-out counts.
Added revision-aware source citations with exact relative path, heading, line range, snippet and source hash, plus a renderer source action that opens and focuses the cited note line.

Added an explicit local grounded-search UI and source-only answer contract that shows selected scope, provider destination none, source-grounded state, missing evidence and no-model-inference labeling.
limitations: This slice does not contact a provider or run model inference; the local vector score is a deterministic feature fallback, not a downloaded embedding model.
Durable incremental index invalidation, provider-neutral model lifecycle, conflicting-claim adjudication, prompt-injection evaluation and cross-vault release scoring remain pending in P4.1/P4.3.
The Electron binary is unavailable locally, so visible progress/citation automation, screen-reader inspection and cross-platform/reference grounding runs remain external-pending.
